implemented: Goals issues an opaque process-local generation-bound capability and canonical proof for one terminal event-wait whole-goal assessment after revalidating the current owner route, goal definition, trigger run and Verifier accepted task.

The feedback target is selected only from the current wake native revision, terminal round, unique succeeded run and its triggerRun assessment; an older successful assessment cannot be attached to a later wake.

Delivery schema 20 atomically couples the external event-wait result Outbox with an immutable typed goal-outcome sidecar; ordinary goal_schedule wakes and ordinary background metadata do not create this authority.
Before enqueue and provider send, Delivery reacquires the current Goals provider and rechecks proof freshness, active owner lineage, route, binding, session and exact background send Policy.

After a provider message exists, the exact owner may reply with feedback status, CAS correction or withdrawal. Historical receipt expiry is allowed only while the immutable Goals and Verifier identity is rebuilt and remains exact.

Evaluation owner-objective-revision/v2 adopts the current whole-goal receipt as revision one, applies version and previous-status CAS, and publishes withdrawal as a canonical unknown retract consumed by the existing Skills monitor.

When Evaluation was offline until the immutable receipt expired, current Goals and Verifier identity can atomically reconstruct the original trusted outcome and revision-one baseline without extending or rewriting that receipt.
Delivery schema 20 validates every sidecar CHECK, foreign key and index at startup; Web owner diagnostics and all new ABI peers require the matching post-0.1.24 cohort.
Legacy or malformed active qualified skill deployments without exact canonical quorum reopen blocked, cannot claim or dispatch, and are never auto-unblocked.
Lark uses its existing reply-to-provider-message identity and adds no target-specific callback or trust authority. Native Web sessions have no external reply identity and are excluded.
